name: bibuzaohua
description: 笔补造化 BiBu Zaohua — reshape AI's Chinese prose with the Book of Songs (诗经) and Songs of Chu (楚辞). Teaches 兴 evocation, 风骨 bone-and-breath, and truth-over-ornament so AI writes literature, not information. Triggers on Chinese verse/literary-prose tasks and soulless-text rewrites.
